package.description: AI assisted scientific copilot + multi-user spatial computing to accelerate scientific discovery drug discovery.

en-US.description: AI assisted scientific copilot + multi-user spatial computing to accelerate scientific discovery drug discovery.
en-US.longDescription: Nanome is the ultimate interface for scientific discovery, starting with molecular data. With Nanome, top R&D labs conduct cutting-edge research but, Nanome isn’t just for experts, it’s also used by students and amateur scientists studying chemistry and biology. Anyone can build 3D molecules or simulate an entire protein made of hundreds of atoms, all in one collaborative environment. Transform the way you learn and design molecular structures with Nanome.
en-US.name: Nanome

zh-CN.description: AI 辅助科研副驾驶 + 多用户空间计算加速科学发现与药物研发
zh-CN.longDescription: Nanome 是科学探索的终极交互平台，一切从分子数据开始。顶尖研发实验室通过 Nanome 开展前沿研究，但它不仅服务于专家——学习化学与生物的学生和业余科学家同样能使用这个平台。在这个协同环境中，任何人都能构建 3D 分子模型，或模拟由数百个原子组成的完整蛋白质结构。用 Nanome 彻底改变你学习和设计分子结构的方式。
